Commentary.Commentary: That's all from this game. Netherlands have consolidated their position in the points table. Bermuda, on the other hand, end their sorry campaign with a massive defeat. Do join us in a short while at 1930 local (1530 GMT) for the match between Namibia and Singapore. Cheers!

Netherlands skipper, Pieter Seelaar says that winning the game was more important than the net run rate. Tells that Max O'Dowd and Ben Cooper batted superbly and then Ryan ten Doeschate and Colin Ackermann provided the desired finish. Adds that against PNG they knew what went wrong and praises his team for bouncing back and playing like the way they did today. Mentions that he's watching the matches of other group as well and states that the margin of error is very low. He's feeling confident before facing Scotland and tells that they are fully prepared for the big game on Sunday.

Bermuda skipper, Rodney Trott says that it was a great experience for his players in spite of not winning any match. Tells that the other teams deal with the pressure a little better than them. Hopes to go back to the drawing board and come back as a better team. Thanks all the fans who came from Bermuda to support them.

Colin Ackermann is the Man of the Match for his all-round effort! Says that the openers set it up beautifully for him. Adds that they wanted to win the game first and foremost and they were not thinking about the net run rate. Opines that it was a good strip for batting as the ball was coming on quicker to the bat as compared to the ICC Academy ground.

It was a clinical performance from Netherlands to bounce back from their defeat in the last match. The openers provided a powerful start and then the batsmen who followed capitalized to take the score past the 200-run mark. The bowlers also put up an excellent show and never allowed any sniff to Bermuda. They kept on picking wickets at regular intervals and achieved a big win. Everyone executed the plan superbly and Paul van Meekeren with a 3-wicket haul was the pick of the bowlers.

A listless batting performance by Bermuda and they close their campaign with a hefty defeat. The writing was on the wall once the Dutch team posted a total above 200. A good start was the need of the hour for Bermuda but it never came and they started to crumble right from the beginning. There wasn't much fight offered, apart from a cameo by Kamau Leverock, as the Orange team bowled tidily and achieved a massive win which will boost their net run-rate.
Good length delivery on off, Trott defends it out. NETHERLANDS WIN BY 92 RUNS!
Full on middle, O'Brien drives it through mid on for a single.
On a length on middle, O'Brien looks to flick but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
Good length delivery on off, O'Brien defends it out.
FOUR! Short delivery outside off, O'Brien makes room and slaps it over extra cover for a boundary.
On a good length on off, O'Brien defends it off the back foot.
Timm van der Gugten is back into the attack. 2-0-24-1 are his figures so far.
Trott defends this flighted ball outside off back to the bowler.

DROPPED! Flighted on off, Trott looks to drive it down the ground but does so uppishly. The ball goes to the left of the bowler who dives across in that direction in his followthrough but fails to hold onto the catch.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Tossed up on middle, Trott plays it straight back to the bowler.
Loopy on off, Trott defends it to covers.
Tossed up on off, Trott plays it to point.
No hat-trick! Paul goes for another yorker but it's not in the line of the stumps. O'Brien fails to flick and is hit on the pads. Fantastic over and spell from Paul van Meekeren, 4-0-26-3!
George O'Brien is the last man in.

OUT! Corker of a yorker and the leg stump goes for a walk. Van Meekeren is on a hat-trick. Terrific delivery. He nails his yorker and it's too hot to handle for Brangman. By the time his bat comes down, the ball has gone through to uproot the leg pole. Paul has a smile on his face after picking his third wicket of the match.
Rodney Trott is the new batsman in.

OUT! Another one bites the dust! A length delivery in the line of the stumps, Bascome swings his bat across the line for a big shot but doesn't get enough meat behind it. The ball flies and settles down into the hands of Klaassen at long on.
BEATEN! On a good length and outside off, Bascome looks to pull but misses it.
Short of a length delivery on off, Bascome looks to pull but misses it.
FOUR! Excellent shot. Full on off, Bascome lofts it straight over the bowler's head for a boundary.
Paul van Meekeren is back into the attack. 3-0-22-1 are his figures so far.
Tossed up on off, Brangman defends it to the offside.
Tossed up on middle, Brangman works it to mid-wicket.
Tossed up on off, Bascome drives it to long off for a single.

OUT! Roelof van der Merwe is a sharp fielder and makes this tough catch look ridiculously easy. An arm ball is fired in on a fuller length around off. Darrell tries a lofted shot across the line but it takes the inner half and flies over mid-wicket. Roelof picks it early, charges forward from the deep and dives to snap it inches above the ground. Neat and tidy effort and Bermuda lose their 7th wicket.
Derrick Brangman is the new man in.
Tossed up on off, Darrell defends it back to the bowler.
Tossed up on off, Bascome lofts it over mid off. The fielder at long off cleans it up for a single.
Okera Bascome is the new man in. Also, Pieter Seelaar is back into the attack. 2-0-8-1 are his figures so far.

OUT! Leverock holes out! A good cameo from him but it only helped Bermuda in delaying the inevitable. It's an off pace delivery landing full outside off. Leverock goes hard at it and tries to tower it into the stands at long off. But he gets more height than distance on his shot and Ackermann moves across to his right in the deep to grab the skier safely.
Bowls a slower ball outside off, Leverock looks to swing but misses it.
SIX! Two in two! Short delivery on leg, Leverock pulls it over short fine leg for a biggie.
SIX! What a shot! Length delivery on middle, Leverock comes down the track and lofts it over mid-wicket for a maximum.
On a length on off, Darrell pushes it towards covers and takes a single.
Length delivery on off, Leverock plays it towards covers for a run.
Timm van der Gugten is back on. 1-0-10-0 are his figures so far.
Darrell defends this length ball to the off side.
Short one on middle, Leverock pulls it to mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! Length and outside off, Leverock creams the drive through covers. The fielder from long off runs to his right but comes second as the ball races away to the fence.
Length and on off, Darrell lofts it over the bowler. The fielder at long on fields and only gives a single.
Length and outside off, Leverock plays it to point for a single.
Length and outside off, Darrell drives it to long off for a single.
Shane Snater comes on to bowl.
SIX! Amazing shot. Short delivery on middle, Leverock pulls it over mid-wicket and it has gone the distance.
Bowls a bouncer, Leverock does well to duck under it.
Short on off, Leverock cuts it through point. The batsmen get two runs.
Length delivery on middle, Leverock tucks it towards the leg side.

DROPPED! Full on middle, Darrell tries to go downtown but fails to get enough distance. He ends up chipping it in the air over mid on and Klaassen there runs back a bit to attempt the catch. But he fails to hold on and drops a sitter. A single is taken.
On a good length on off, Darrell defends it off the back foot.
Paul van Meekeren is back into the attack. 2-0-13-1 are his figures so far.
FOUR! Tossed up and outside off, Leverock dances down the track and lofts it over the bowler. The ball just about bounces inside the ropes before crossing it. A boundary to end the over.
Tossed up on middle and leg, Darrell flicks it to mid-wicket for a single.

Tossed up outside off, Darrell looks to pull but gets beaten as the ball goes past the outside edge. Scott Edwards behind the wickets too fails to collect it cleanly. Nevertheless Darrell was well inside the crease. So no chance of a stumping.
Tossed up on the pads, Darrell flicks it through mid-wicket and gets a couple.
Tossed up on off, Darrell plays it back to the bowler at the last minute.
Tossed up on off, Darrell plays it to point.
Tossed up outside off, Leverock looks to cut but misses it. 6 runs and a wicket from the over.
Floated delivery on off, Leverock punches it to point.
Kamau Leverock is the new batsman in.

OUT! CAUGHT! Short delivery on middle, Douglas pulls it over square leg but does not get the distance on it. It flies in the air and Max O'Dowd runs behind from short fine leg  to take a good catch. The fight is over from Douglas and Bermuda lose half their side now.
Floated delivery on middle, Douglas flicks it through square leg. The batsmen get two runs.
Flighted delivery on leg, Douglas looks to flick but gets hit on the pads. The bowler appeals for lbw but the umpire shakes his head.
FOUR! Cracking shot. Short of a length delivery outside off, Douglas cuts it hard through point for a boundary.
Pieter Seelaar is back into the attack. 1-0-2-0 are his figures so far.
Tossed up on off, Darrell defend it back to the bowler.
Deunte Darrell is the next batsman in.

OUT! BOWLED! Slider from van der Merwe on off, Tucker looks to cut it past point. But he is nowhere in position to play that. In the end he gets cramped for room and the ball crashes into the off stump. Bermuda in dire straits with four down.
FOUR! Tossed up outside off, Tucker lofts it cleanly over the bowler and sends it rolling to the long off fence. A welcome boundary.
Tossed up on off, Tucker defends it to point.
Tossed up on the pads, Douglas works it to the leg side for a single.
Tossed up outside off, Douglas defends it to point.
Roelof van der Merwe comes on now.
Short delivery on middle, Douglas pulls it through square leg for a run.

FOUR! Nice shot. Short delivery on middle, Douglas pulls it over mid-wicket. The fielder in the deep picks it late, tries to give a charge but overruns slightly and then loses the sight of the ball, maybe. It arrives and lands wide of him before racing away to the fence.
Tossed up delivery on off, Douglas punches it to point.
Short delivery on middle, Douglas pulls it to mid-wicket.
Flighted delivery on off, Douglas plays it to point.
Tossed up delivery on off, Douglas defends it off the back foot.
Colin Ackermann is back into the attack. 1-0-1-1 are his figures so far.
Length and on the pads, Douglas works it to the leg side for a single.
Length and on off, Tucker drives this to long off. A single taken.
BEATEN! Douglas looks to  pull it to the leg side but the ball keeps low and sneaks under the bat.
Length and on off, Douglas punches it through covers off the back foot. A run taken.
Length and on pads, Tucker flicks it through square leg for a single.
Length and outside off, Douglas looks to go over the leg side but gets an outside edge which goes down to third man. The fielder there cleans it up. A single taken.
Fred Klaassen comes back on. 1-0-6-0 are his figures so far.
Short and outside off, Tucker cuts it to point.
Short on off, Douglas cuts it towards point for a single.
Loopy delivery on middle, Tucker sweeps it towards square leg for a run.
Floated delivery on off, Tucker plays it to point.
FOUR! Nice shot. Tossed up on off, Tucker drives it through covers for a boundary.
Flighted delivery on off, Tucker punches it to point.

Floated delivery on middle, Tucker nudges it towards square leg for a single.
Full delivery on off, Tucker drives it to covers.

Tossed up delivery on middle, Tucker defends it off the back foot.
Flighted delivery on middle, Douglas sweeps it through square leg for a run.
Flighted delivery outside off, Douglas looks to cut but misses it.
Janeiro Tucker is the new man in. Pieter Seelaar is into the attack.

OUT! The bowler gets his revenge and is all pumped up. Paul van Meekeren sticks to bowling in the line of the stumps and Rawlins once again tries to be cheeky with his paddle scoop. Delray is way too early in shuffling across the stumps and he is so far away from the line of the ball that he ends up missing it completely. The leg stump is disturbed and the short stay of Rawlins is over.
The batsman drives this through the covers.

FOUR! Innovative here. Van Meekeren follows the batsman as he shuffles across the stumps. He bangs it in short and Rawlins just comes inside the line of the ball to paddle it past the keeper and into the fine leg fence. A welcome boundary here for Bermuda.

DROPPED! Van Meekeren is the culprit here. Paul bowls it on the shorter side and Rawlins looks to pull. But he only manages to mistime it towards the bowler. He tries to catch it by stretching his hands but it spills out. A lucky escape for the batsman there.
Length and on middle, Rawlins flicks it to mid-wicket for a couple.
Length and on middle, Douglas flicks it to the leg side for a single.
Paul van Meekeren comes back on.
SIX! That is huge! On a length on middle, Rawlins lofts it over long on for a maximum. 10 runs have come from the over.
Length delivery on middle, Rawlins tucks it to mid-wicket.
On a length on off, Douglas taps it towards point for a single.
On a good length on off, Douglas punches it to point.
Length delivery on leg, Douglas looks to flick but gets hit on the pads.
Length delivery on middle, Rawlins lofts it high over mid-wicket. It falls safely in no man's land. The batsmen get three runs. Good running between the wickets.
Timm van der Gugten comes on now.
Short on off, Douglas cuts it to point. Another tidy over by Netherlands, just a run and a wicket from it.
Flighted delivery on middle, Rawlins flicks it towards square leg where the fielder dives and does well to stop it. The batsmen still manage to take a single.

OUT! Another one trapped in front of the wickets! Both the openers are back in the hut without doing any damage. Ackermann gets a flighted delivery to spin back into the batsman from outside off. Stovell is caught on the back foot attempting to work it on the leg side. But he is beaten by the spin on the ball and is thudded on the pads. The umpire wastes no time in raising his finger after the appeal from the Dutch players. The dismal tournament with the bat continues for Bermuda.
Floated delivery on off, Stovell defends it out.
Flighted delivery on middle, Stovell flicks it to mid-wicket.
Tossed up delivery on middle, Stovell plays it towards the leg side.
Colin Ackermann comes into the attack.
FOUR!  Full toss on middle, Douglas looks to flick but gets an outside edge. It goes towards third man for a boundary. 6 runs and a wicket from the over.
Allan Douglas is the next batsman in.

OUT! That's plumb in front! Van der Merwe has fooled the batsman with a well-disguised arm ball. He delivers it from wide of the crease and lands it close to the off stump line. The ball pitches and skids into the right-hander who picks it very late and then tries to bail himself out by playing the flick shot. But he fails to put bat on ball and gets rapped on the pads. The appeal goes up and so does the finger. Early setback in this run chase for Bermuda and Roelof roars in celebration.
Flighted delivery on middle, Stovell comes down the track and flicks it towards mid-wicket for a single.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.

Flighted delivery on off, Bascome looks to flick but misses it. It goes over the stumps and the keeper also misses it. It goes towards fine leg. The batsmen take a single. The umpire gives it as a bye.
Roelof van der Merwe is into the attack.

FOUR! Short and on middle, Stovell pulls it through mid-wicket. The fielder from square leg runs to his left but fails to pull the ball back. The ball finally crosses the rope. The umpire signals it a boundary.

Length and on off, Stovell defends it off the back foot to the off side.
Paul van Meekeren to bowl from other end.

BEATEN! On a good length and outside off, Stovell looks to cut but misses it.

DROPPED! Good attempt nonetheless. A shortish delivery just around off, too close to cut but Bascome still opts to execute that shot. Ends up getting a thick outside edge behind and Edwards flies to his right to attempt for the catch. It brushes his gloves and deflects down to third man. Early life for Oronde and he crosses to the other end.
On a good length on middle, Bascome looks to flick but gets hit on the thigh pad.
FOUR! First boundary for Bermuda. Short delivery on middle, Bascome pulls it through mid-wicket for a boundary.
Starts with a good length delivery on off, Bascome defends it off the back foot.
We are back for the chase. The Netherlands players are out in the middle. Dion Stovell and Oronde Bascome will open the batting for Bermuda. Fred Klaassen will start the proceedings for Netherlands.
